name: TN-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district (R+18 PVI) with an incumbent running
Massive fundraising gap: Fleischmann $4.8M on hand vs. ~$34K for Golladay
No competitive polling; prediction markets give Democrat ~4%
Multiple independent candidates may fragment minor opposition
model.rationale: The baseline (-17.8) is reinforced by Fleischmann's incumbency, overwhelming financial advantage, and a Polymarket price implying ~4% for the Democrat, so I nudge slightly toward Republicans to about -19.
model.watch: A major outside-spending surge or scandal involving Fleischmann could tighten the race, though history suggests little movement in districts this red.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Chuck Fleischmann seeks another term in a Chattanooga-area district that leans heavily Republican, about 18 points to the right of the nation. He was renominated without difficulty and enters the general election with a large war chest of roughly $4.8 million. Democrat Anna Golladay has raised modest sums, and several independent candidates are also on the ballot, likely splitting any anti-incumbent vote.

There is no public general-election polling, and no expert ratings cover the race. Prediction markets price Fleischmann's chances around 94 percent. With the fundamentals, money, and market all pointing the same direction, this race is rated Safe Republican with high confidence.
